features_metadata.name: erythema
features_metadata.description: Redness of the skin caused by increased blood flow in superficial capillaries.

features_metadata.name: scaling
features_metadata.description: Flaking or peeling of the top layer of skin (stratum corneum).

features_metadata.name: definite_borders
features_metadata.description: Sharp demarcation between affected skin lesions and surrounding normal skin.

features_metadata.name: itching
features_metadata.description: Subjective sensation provoking the desire to scratch affected skin.

features_metadata.name: koebner_phenomenon
features_metadata.description: Appearance of new lesions at sites of mechanical trauma or skin irritation.

features_metadata.name: polygonal_papules
features_metadata.description: Small, raised lesions with multi-sided angular borders (typical of Lichen Planus).

features_metadata.name: follicular_papules
features_metadata.description: Small, inflammatory bumps located specifically around hair follicles.

features_metadata.name: oral_mucosal_involvement
features_metadata.description: Presence of white lesions, reticular streaks, or ulcers in the mouth lining.

features_metadata.name: knee_and_elbow_involvement
features_metadata.description: Prominent lesion presence over extensor surfaces (knees and elbows).

features_metadata.name: scalp_involvement
features_metadata.description: Presence of erythematous or scaling lesions across the hairy scalp.

features_metadata.name: family_history
features_metadata.description: History of similar dermatological diseases among direct family members (0: No, 1: Yes).

features_metadata.name: melanin_incontinence
features_metadata.description: Deposition of melanin pigment granules into the papillary dermis from basal layer damage.

features_metadata.name: eosinophils_infiltrate
features_metadata.description: Infiltration of eosinophil granulocytes in tissue biopsy sections.

features_metadata.name: PNL_infiltrate
features_metadata.description: Infiltration of polymorphonuclear leukocytes (neutrophils) in tissue.

features_metadata.name: fibrosis_papillary_dermis
features_metadata.description: Collagen deposition and early scarring in the upper superficial dermal layer.

features_metadata.name: exocytosis
features_metadata.description: Migration of inflammatory mononuclear cells from dermis into the epidermis.

features_metadata.name: acanthosis
features_metadata.description: Diffuse epidermal hyperplasia and thickening of the spinous layer.

features_metadata.name: hyperkeratosis
features_metadata.description: Excessive thickening of the outermost stratum corneum layer of skin.

features_metadata.name: parakeratosis
features_metadata.description: Retention of cell nuclei in the stratum corneum reflecting accelerated keratinization.

features_metadata.name: clubbing_rete_ridges
features_metadata.description: Club-shaped bulbous swelling and downward elongation of epidermal rete ridges.

features_metadata.name: elongation_rete_ridges
features_metadata.description: Regular or irregular downward elongation of interpapillary rete ridges.

features_metadata.name: thinning_suprapapillary_epidermis
features_metadata.description: Marked thinning of the epidermal layer overlying dermal papillae.

features_metadata.name: spongiform_pustule
features_metadata.description: Intercellular pustules created by neutrophil accumulations in spinous layer (Kogoj pustule).

features_metadata.name: munro_microabcess
features_metadata.description: Focal aggregates of pyknotic neutrophils within the stratum corneum.

features_metadata.name: focal_hypergranulosis
features_metadata.description: Focal thickening and prominent coarse keratohyalin granules in the granular layer.

features_metadata.name: disappearance_granular_layer
features_metadata.description: Attenuated or absent stratum granulosum beneath parakeratotic areas.

features_metadata.name: vacuolisation_damage_basal_layer
features_metadata.description: Liquefactive or hydropic degeneration of basal keratinocytes with vacuole formation.

features_metadata.name: spongiosis
features_metadata.description: Intercellular edema within the epidermis widening spaces between keratinocytes.

features_metadata.name: saw_tooth_appearance_retes
features_metadata.description: Pointed, jagged triangular contour of the lower borders of rete pegs.

features_metadata.name: follicular_horn_plug
features_metadata.description: Dense keratinous plug obstructing the infundibulum of hair follicles.

features_metadata.name: perifollicular_parakeratosis
features_metadata.description: Parakeratosis localized specifically surrounding follicular ostia.

features_metadata.name: inflammatory_mononuclear_infiltrate
features_metadata.description: Presence of lymphocytes, histiocytes, and macrophages in dermal tissue.

features_metadata.name: band_like_infiltrate
features_metadata.description: Dense horizontal band of lymphocytic infiltrate hugging the dermal-epidermal junction.

1.name: Psoriasis
1.description: A chronic autoimmune skin disease characterized by well-demarcated, erythematous plaques covered with silvery scales, commonly over extensor surfaces.

2.name: Seborrheic Dermatitis
2.description: A common inflammatory skin disorder affecting sebum-rich areas such as scalp, face, and chest, presenting with greasy scales over erythematous patches.

3.name: Lichen Planus
3.description: A chronic inflammatory condition of skin and mucous membranes characterized by pruritic, polygonal, violaceous flat-topped papules.

4.name: Pityriasis Rosea
4.description: An acute, self-limiting exanthem characterized by an initial herald patch followed by oval erythematous scaling lesions along skin cleavage lines.

5.name: Chronic Dermatitis
5.description: Long-standing eczema/dermatitis characterized by thickened skin (lichenification), scaling, erythema, and persistent itching.

6.name: Pityriasis Rubra Pilaris
6.description: A rare group of chronic disorders characterized by reddish-orange follicular papules, palmoplantar keratoderma, and islands of normal skin.
